page_title: TOR 2-1 ATA | Torino v Atalanta 25/08/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+10' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+9' Nicolo Zaniolo (Atalanta) gets a precise pass from the edge of the box and swiftly strikes, but his shot misses to the left of the target.
90+8' Marco Carnesecchi pulls off a glorious save! Duvan Zapata (Torino) attempts to head home after a precise lofted cross. However, his effort only finds its way into the goalkeeper gloves.
90+8' Paolo Vanoli prepares a substitution. Samuele Ricci is replaced by Aaron Ciammaglichella (Torino).
90+8' That's the end of the game for Che Adams, who is replaced by Yann Karamoh (Torino).
90+7' Nicolo Zaniolo (Atalanta) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Antonio Rapuano ignores the protests.

90+6' Vanja Milinkovic-Savic anticipates the direction of the penalty by Mario Pasalic (Atalanta). He attempted to put the ball into the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper was there in time to deny him.
90+6' Mario Pasalic (Atalanta) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
90+5' Here comes the VAR decision. YES, it's a penalty!
90+3' Referee Antonio Rapuano makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty. Let’s see what happens!
90+2' Vanja Milinkovic-Savic (Torino) attempts to discuss the decision with Antonio Rapuano, but he soon realises that it's not the right thing to do as he sees the yellow.
90+2' One of the Atalanta players is in on goal but gets upended by the defender in the box. That could be a penalty, but the ref says NO! Play continues.
90+2' Saul Coco (Torino) makes a strong challenge and Antonio Rapuano blows for a foul.
90' 7 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Alberto Manzoni (Atalanta) commits a foul after unfairly battling his opponent for the ball.
90' A poor mid-range free-kick by Lazar Samardzic (Atalanta) is easily blocked by the defensive wall.
89' Today's referee Antonio Rapuano rightly decides to book Duvan Zapata (Torino) for his harsh tackle.
88' Flag up against Adam Masina (Torino). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
88' Adam Masina (Torino) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
86' Adam Masina (Torino) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
86' Alberto Manzoni (Atalanta) got the ball on the edge of the box and produced a strong shot, but one of his teammates was standing in the wrong place and unintentionally blocked the effort.
85' Gian Piero Gasperini decides to make a substitution. Charles De Ketelaere will be replaced by Federico Cassa (Atalanta).
85' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Ederson departs the field of play to be replaced by Alberto Manzoni (Atalanta).
84' Lazar Samardzic (Atalanta) picks up a pass and tries his luck from mid-range towards the middle of the goal, but Vanja Milinkovic-Savic is equal to it and makes an easy save.
83' Here comes the ref’s decision after the VAR review. It’s not penalty as the referee indicates there was no infringement.
83' Wait! The referee makes the VAR signal and he's going to review that incident in the box from earlier. This could be a penalty for Atalanta! Let's see what he decides.
82' Ederson (Atalanta) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
80' Fine attempt! Nicolo Zaniolo (Atalanta) collects a pass and manages to hold off the defender, then rifles in a shot from mid-range which unluckily swerves inches past the left post.
79' Ivan Ilic (Torino) stands over the resultant free kick from mid-range, but his shot goes just over the crossbar. It could have been a fantastic goal!
78' Mergim Vojvoda is substituted due to injury. Paolo Vanoli gives a chance to Borna Sosa (Torino).
77' Berat Djimsiti (Atalanta) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Antonio Rapuano didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
76' Mergim Vojvoda (Torino) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
75' Karol Linetty (Torino) trips an opposition player and Antonio Rapuano signals a foul.
75' Duvan Zapata (Torino) latches on to a sweet cross inside the box and misses with a header high above the bar.
74' The corner from Valentino Lazaro (Torino) is intercepted by Marco Carnesecchi.
74' The ball is cleared after Valentino Lazaro (Torino) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. It will be a corner kick for Torino.
73' Marco Carnesecchi is alert and has a clear sight of a long through ball from Samuele Ricci (Torino). Easy save!
71' The referee blows his whistle and players are going to refresh themselves.
70' Gian Piero Gasperini has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Marco Palestra (Atalanta) replacing Isak Hien.
70' The referee allows time for a substitution. Mateo Retegui will be replaced by Nicolo Zaniolo (Atalanta).
70' Ederson (Atalanta) is able to continue to play.
69' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Torino, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
68' Ederson (Atalanta) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
68' Antonio Rapuano blows his whistle and signals a foul after Ederson (Atalanta) brought his opponent down.
67' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Ali Dembele (Torino) comes onto the pitch so that Adrien Tameze can be given a rest.
66' Lazar Samardzic (Atalanta) receives a pass and decides to smash the ball from long range, but his poor effort sails high over the bar.
65' Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) leaps high to meet a lofted pass inside the six-yard box, but his header only flies onto the left post and away off it.
64' Torino have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

63' Che Adams (Torino) gets to the rebound on the edge of the penalty area and fires a shot towards the top right corner, but Marco Carnesecchi gets a hand to it and keeps it out. Torino have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
63' Excellent touch by Duvan Zapata (Torino)! He latches on to a precise pass deep into the box and unleashes a low drive towards the left post, but the goalkeeper pulls off a terrific save.
62' A flowing move ends with a great cross into the centre of the box, which Mateo Retegui (Atalanta) latches onto but sends a wild header well wide of the right post.

59' Mario Pasalic (Atalanta) must be feeling really frustrated right now. He managed to meet the rebound and sent in a nice header from close range. However, Vanja Milinkovic-Savic pulled off an amazing save out of the blue to deny his promising effort towards the middle of the goal.
59' Mateo Retegui (Atalanta) fires a rebound from close range onto the bar!
59' The ball is out of play. Atalanta will have a chance to score from a corner.

59' Ederson (Atalanta) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went low towards the middle of the target, but Vanja Milinkovic-Savic was alert and the score remained the same.
55' Karol Linetty (Torino) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Antonio Rapuano blows for a foul.
55' That's a well-taken pass by Valentino Lazaro (Torino). He unleashes a strike from the edge of the box, but blazes it high over the bar.

54' Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) holds his head in his hands after wasting a promising chance. He latches onto a rebound, creates some space for himself and fires the ball from the edge of the box into the stands.
53' The resulting set piece from Atalanta is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
53' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Lazar Samardzic (Atalanta) is coming onto the pitch as Marco Brescianini cannot continue after picking up an injury.
49' 2 - 1 Goal! Che Adams (Torino) is quickest to react to the rebound and stabs the ball into the back of the net. It's 2:1.
49' Great save! Duvan Zapata (Torino) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot towards the bottom right corner was brilliantly saved by Marco Carnesecchi.
49' Marco Brescianini (Atalanta) found some space to play in a lofted pass, but he looks disappointed as none of his teammates managed to connect with it.
47' Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) sends a cross into the box, but Vanja Milinkovic-Savic comes off his line to gather the ball.
47' Atalanta work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.

46' Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went towards the bottom left corner, but Vanja Milinkovic-Savic was alert and the score remains the same. Atalanta earn a corner.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+5' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+5' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Atalanta, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
45+4' Adam Masina (Torino) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Antonio Rapuano signals.

45+3' Duvan Zapata (Torino) latched on to a cross inside the six-yard box and headed at goal. If it wasn't for one of the defenders making a save on the goal line, he would have been celebrating a goal now.
45+2' Valentino Lazaro (Torino) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.
45+2' Ivan Ilic (Torino) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. Torino will take a corner kick.
45+1' Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) wriggles into space and fires the ball from the edge of the area, but one of the defenders is there to block the effort.
45' We will have 4 min. of added time.
44' Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
41' Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) tries his luck with a promising long-range shot from a rebound, but the ball sails a few inches high over the crossbar. What a great effort!
41' Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) picks up the ball, dribbles to the edge of the penalty area and unleashes a brilliant shot, but is thwarted by a decent save from Vanja Milinkovic-Savic.
40' Ivan Ilic (Torino) picks up a yellow card for a foul.
38' A yellow card for a tackle by Isak Hien (Atalanta). Antonio Rapuano doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
38' Antonio Rapuano interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Ederson (Atalanta).
38' Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) has a snap shot at goal from distance after a rebound falls his way, but the effort is wild and flies miles wide of the right post.
37' Matteo Ruggeri (Atalanta) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.
37' A cross into the box from Matteo Ruggeri (Atalanta) is cleared. The ball goes out for a corner. Atalanta can continue in their attacking effort.
36' The corner is swung in but Torino can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
36' A snap shot from distance by Samuele Ricci (Torino) after a precise pass is brilliantly blocked by a defender. Torino have a corner.
35' A cross by Matteo Ruggeri (Atalanta) from the side of the pitch flies into the box, but fails to find its intended target as the aim was poor.
34' Valentino Lazaro (Torino) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
34' Atalanta failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
32' Valentino Lazaro (Torino) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
31' 1 - 1 GOAL - 1:1! Che Adams found Ivan Ilic (Torino) inside the box, he spotted goalkeeper Marco Carnesecchi off his line and chipped the ball into the net. What a cheeky lob!
29' Mario Pasalic (Atalanta) sees a yellow card from Antonio Rapuano after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
27' It’s hot out there so the ref signals there will be a cooling break for the players to take on some fluids.
26' 0 - 1 Davide Zappacosta floats a delightful ball in and finds the head of Mateo Retegui (Atalanta), who steers a header into the top left corner off the post. The score is 0:1.
25' Saul Coco (Torino) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle.
22' Antonio Rapuano has a clear sight and sees a foul from Berat Djimsiti (Atalanta).
21' None of the Atalanta players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play.

20' Mateo Retegui (Atalanta) weaves through the defence and gets one-on-one with the keeper, but fails to score. The ball goes behind for a corner. Atalanta will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
18' Marten de Roon (Atalanta) was too forceful with his tackle and Antonio Rapuano interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
17' Marten de Roon (Atalanta) manages to dispossess his opponent of the ball, but he commits a foul in the process and the referee blows his whistle.
16' Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The ball has crossed the sideline. Atalanta are taking a throw-in.
14' Mateo Retegui (Atalanta) is penalised for a foul. Antonio Rapuano had a clear view and blows his whistle.
12' Ederson (Atalanta) produced a promising shot towards the bottom right corner after his wonderful solo run, but Vanja Milinkovic-Savic thwarted him with a fabulous save.
11' Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Vanja Milinkovic-Savic comes off the line to clear the ball away.
8' Atalanta are showcasing great team work and neat passing moves.
6' Marten de Roon (Atalanta) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Antonio Rapuano no option but to blow his whistle.
4' That was close by Valentino Lazaro (Torino)! He receives a pass on the edge of the box and shoots, but the ball goes by a whisker over the crossbar.
3' Atalanta string together a series of short passes.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out at last! Atalanta will take the kick-off.
Antonio Rapuano got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
